$comment: DRAFT ledger for issue #60: Bong Joon-ho only. Same schema as essential10-example.json (schemaVersion 1); extra optional fields: films[].flags, nearMisses[].imdb/rt. Not approved, not for app use until the owner signs off the roster, the method and the score-display licensing decision.
methodSummary: Eligibility (sole or credited TMDB Directing credit, feature or, where flagged, feature-length documentary) -> longlist with evidence panel -> tier by directing achievement (craft, innovation, influence, canon) with IMDb and RT used only as within-source ordinal sanity checks -> order within tier by documented editorial judgement. IMDb /10 and Tomatometer % are never averaged or combined.

imdb.source: IMDb non-commercial dataset title.ratings.tsv.gz (ratings and vote counts); title.basics and title.crew used to match ids and confirm sole directors
imdb.note: Dataset file run-date 2026-11-12, last-modified 2026-11-13 00:28 GMT. The live IMDb title page returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool on 2026-11-13, so ratings were not cross-checked against live pages. Dataset licence is personal / non-commercial use only; see SCORE_SOURCING_NOTES.md.

rt.source: Rotten Tomatoes film page, critics Tomatometer percentage and its critic review count
rt.note: Read through a text-extraction fetch tool, one film page at a time. Percentages were cross-checked against the RT celebrity filmography table where it listed them and, for some films, against search-result summaries of the same page. Review counts are live and change daily; each is a single dated read.

films.title: Parasite
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: A black-and-white version released in 2020 (Parasite: Black & White) exists as a separate entry; this ledger uses the original colour film.

films.rationale: A tragicomic class thriller built on the precise layout of two houses and a mid-film change of genre; won the Palme d'Or and the Oscars for Best Picture and Best Director; top on both evidence lines (IMDb 8.5, RT 99% from 484 reviews).

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: WARNING: RT /m/memories_of_murder is an unrelated 1990 TV film; use the _2003 slug.

films.rationale: A serial-killer procedural that becomes a portrait of a country under dictatorship and of the failure of method; among the most acclaimed Korean films and strong on both evidence lines.

films.title: Mother
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2010 (US release); original release was 2009. WARNING: IMDb tt1560161 and several shorts share the title 'Mother'; tt1216496 is Bong's film.

films.rationale: A mystery in which a mother's devotion turns into something frightening; the most concentrated and compact film of his, with an RT score of 96% from 120 reviews.

films.title: The Host
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2007 (US release); original release was 2006.

films.rationale: A monster film with family comedy and political satire that became a major Korean box-office success and a model for his genre-mixing.

films.title: Snowpiercer
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT lists 2014 (US release); original release was 2013.

films.rationale: A science-fiction class allegory staged on one train; his first largely English-language film and strong critic standing, though lower on IMDb.

films.title: Okja
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).
films.rationale: A girl-and-animal adventure with a satire of corporate food systems; a film that shows his tonal range but is more uneven.

films.title: Barking Dogs Never Bite
films.directorCreditNote: Sole director (TMDB Directing credit; IMDb dataset lists the same sole director).

rt.rtYearNote: RT sample of 17 reviews is below the 20-review comfort threshold; IMDb votes (12,295) are just over the 10,000 floor.

films.rationale: His debut, a black comedy about apartment-block neighbours; the earliest sign of his control of tone, included as the seventh and closest call (see below).

nearMisses.title: Mickey 17
nearMisses.reason: A science-fiction satire; the weakest evidence in his filmography (IMDb 6.7, RT 77% from 363 reviews) and too recent for a fixed list. Owner could include it as an eighth film.

nearMisses.title: Tokyo! (segment 'Shaking Tokyo')
nearMisses.reason: Anthology film co-directed with Leos Carax and Michel Gondry; Bong directed one segment. Excluded as a segment; TMDB lists it as a movie credit.

rt.reason: Not read in this pass; not needed for the decision.

unverified: TMDB film ids and Directing credits were read from the TMDB person page on 2026-11-13 (no TMDB API key was available), not from the API crew.job field; title-to-id pairs were taken from the page links. Co-director status was checked against the IMDb dataset crew file (title.crew), which lists a sole director for every film in the list.
IMDb ids were matched in the IMDb dataset by original title, year and runtime, not read from a TMDB external_ids field; confirm with the TMDB API external_ids at implementation.
RT review counts are a single read on the stated date via a text fetcher.
IMDb title pages could not be read (HTTP 403); ratings and votes come from the official dataset (not cross-checked against the live pages), whose licence is non-commercial only.
